summary.plain: The team of scientists, based at UC Irvine and partner institutions, who built and ran the now-decommissioned ARIANNA pilot neutrino experiment on the Ross Ice Shelf.
summary.technical: Collaboration (hosted at UC Irvine) that operated the ARIANNA pilot radio-detection array on the Ross Ice Shelf, now decommissioned; no published total membership count found this session.
